meta.name: critique
meta.description: Evaluate design effectiveness from a UX perspective. Assesses visual hierarchy, information architecture, emotional resonance, and overall design quality with actionable feedback.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估设计稿的UX质量并给出改进建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从用户体验角度审视设计稿并获取可落地的反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate design quality from a UX perspective with actionable feedback.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need UX critique and actionable feedback on your designs.

howto.what: Claude 会从用户体验角度评估你的界面设计，检查视觉层次、信息架构、情感共鸣等维度，并给出具体改进建议。
howto.when: 当你上传或描述一个界面设计，并请求设计评审时触发。

say.text: 帮我评审这个网页设计，指出最需要改进的地方。
say.note: Claude 会输出一份完整的设计评审报告。

say.text: 这个界面看起来像AI生成的吗？有哪些AI痕迹？
say.note: Claude 会重点检测AI生成特征。

howto.what_en: Claude evaluates your interface design from a UX perspective, checking visual hierarchy, information architecture, emotional resonance, and provides actionable feedback.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you upload or describe an interface design and request a design critique.

say_en.text: Review this web design and point out the top improvements.
say_en.note: Claude will output a full design critique report.

say_en.text: Does this interface look AI-generated? What are the tells?
say_en.note: Claude will focus on detecting AI-generated patterns.
